title: スプリンターズSにむけて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The bout with Taiki Shuttle at the Yasuda Kinen makes headlines, prompting many people to cram into the Nakayama Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fans can't stop talking about how invigorating Hishi Akebono's races are, and how captivating the way she uses her size to run is.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hishi Akebono will be making her decision about her future today, after the Sprinters S. Her gaze is steady and serious as she steps up to the gate.
